exposure: Planned mode of delivery (waiting for spontaneous labor)
Planned mode of delivery (induction of labor)
Planned mode of delivery (non-labor cesarean section - NLCS)
cohort: The study included 27,472 nulliparous women with obesity who had live, singleton, and uncomplicated term gestations between April 2012 and March 2019.
finding: Planned non-labor cesarean section (NLCS) was associated with a reduced risk of overall, maternal-specific, and neonatal-specific Adverse Outcome Index compared to spontaneous labor at term gestation.
mod_finding: Planned non-labor cesarean section (NLCS) was associated with a 41% reduced risk of overall Adverse Outcome Index, a 54% reduced risk of maternal-specific AOI, and a 30% reduced risk of neonatal-specific AOI compared to spontaneous labor among women with obesity.
